snippet.title: CLAUSTRUM — Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Claustrum is an atmospheric first-person exploration game set within an endless brutalist megastructure. Navigate dark industrial corridors, interact with forgotten machinery, and uncover the mystery of a dormant complex that was never meant to wake up.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5011040/CLAUSTRUM/

Join Claustrum on Discord:
https://discord.gg/jmnRNVe4W

Play Free Demo soon on Steam!
Subscribe to the channel for more dev updates.



Music & Sound Design by HelDen Games






#indiegame #brutalism #liminalspace #ps1graphics #indiedev #gamedev
